settings.position_info: On product image puts the heart in the bottom-right corner of the card image, just above any colour swatches. Only applies inside product cards; on the product page it stays inline.
settings.image_bg_opacity_info: White circle behind the heart on product images. 0% = no circle.
settings.icon_color_info: Leave empty to match the surrounding text colour.
settings.show_label: Show text next to the icon
settings.overrides_info: Leave empty to use the built-in translations (English, German, French, Spanish).
